Name: Languishing Wind
Description: You breathe out a cone of sinister, wind-like energy in a 30-foot cone originating from you. All mundane living matter (including magical plant matter from spells such as entangle) in this cone (that is not part of a creature) dies and withers away immediately, and any other creature caught within it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures who fail by 5 points or more are made sluggish for 1 minute, and may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect early on a success.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each level above 2nd:
● The cone extends by 30 feet.
● The cone deals an additional 2d6 necrotic damage.
● (2 slot levels) Creatures who fail the saving throw are made sluggish, as described above, even if they don’t fail by 5 points or more.
